Welcome to /v/RemoteVolunteering!

If you're looking for volunteer work from the Voat community, post your skills here and the kind of work you're looking for. Start your post titles with the [Volunteer] tag so everyone knows you're looking!

Things to include when posting as a Volunteer:

  • A descriptive and accurate title. e.g. "Graphic Design student looking for logo and branding projects to work on."
  • Bulleted details on your skills and experience level in those skills. e.g. "Two years of design experience with Adobe Creative Suite products."
  • A link to your LinkedIn page, if that's something you're comfortable with. (optional)
  • Don't forget the [Volunteer] tag in the title. This will help the right people see your post.

Have a start-up or personal project that you're wanting to connect with a volunteer on? Check out some of the postings by volunteers looking to sharpen their skills and gain valuable experience or make a post of your own. Start your post titles with the [Opportunity] tag to get volunteer attention!

Things to include when posting an Opportunity:

  • A descriptive and accurate title of the opportunity available. e.g. "Web startup looking for a volunteer developer to help with our Ecommerce store."
  • Bulleted details on the skills that are helpful or specifically required. .e.g. "Knowledge of responsive CSS (Bootstrap) is extremely helpful, but an intermediate knowledge of PHP is required."
  • Provide a contact email address or provide a contact link if Voat won't be monitored regularly, but we recommend that you do to answer any questions in the post.
  • Include the [Opportunity] tag in your post title.

Happy posting, Voaters!
